public_rationale: Bloomberg's February 24, 2025 report attributed canceled US leases totaling “a couple of hundred megawatts” and reduced conversion of preliminary agreements to TD Cowen's checks [e1]. The report supplies neither a complete abandoned-capacity total with duplicate projects excluded nor Microsoft's contemporaneous operating capacity on a comparable power basis [e1]. It therefore cannot establish whether abandoned expansion exceeded 14% of operating capacity during February through March 3, 2025 [e1].
limitations: The evidence does not verify Microsoft's operating capacity during the target period [e1].
Project overlap and comparable power measurements remain unverified [e1].
The original TD Cowen report and project records were not obtained.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Microsoft has effectively abandoned data center expansion equivalent to over 14% of its current capacity.

statement.excerpt: As a result, based on TD Cowen's analysis, Microsoft has, through a combination of canceled leases, pullbacks on Statements of Qualifications, cancellations of land parcels and deliberate expiration of Letters of Intent, effectively abandoned data center expansion equivalent to over 14% of its current capacity.

from_speaker: deliberate expiration of Letters of Intent
our_interpretation: Abandoned expansion includes proposed projects and expired agreements, as the speaker explicitly specifies; it does not mean operating facilities were closed.
The comparison requires abandoned prospective capacity divided by Microsoft's contemporaneous operating capacity, measured on a comparable power basis.
The target period covers the latest February reporting through the post date. It describes the reported state of the expansion pipeline, not necessarily the dates every agreement expired.
The contextual 6–7 GW denominator is an estimate requiring verification, not an established measurement.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable capacity records establish that the abandoned expansion exceeded 14% of Microsoft's operating capacity at the time, without double-counting projects.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that the abandoned expansion was no more than 14% of contemporaneous operating capacity.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft has pulled back on converting so-called statements of qualifications
evidence.locator: Paragraph following the opening paragraph and the Most Read links
evidence.explanation: The full report also attributes more than 1 GW of expired agreements and several additional proposed deals to TD Cowen. This supports a substantial abandoned pipeline, but does not supply the operating-capacity denominator needed to establish 14%.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contemporaneous records of operating capacity and abandoned planned capacity, measured on the same power basis and excluding duplicate projects, would establish whether the ratio exceeded 14% during the target period.
